purpose: Place a statement within a distinctive situation or era.
keywords: N + にあって（は / も）
Even in an emergency, she stayed calm.
In this period of change, the role of education is being questioned.
This tree survived in a harsh environment.
Make circumstances a reason or a setting
formation: N + にあって（は / も）
restrictions: Often frames unusual conditions that shape an action.
mistake: にあって presents the setting; とあって presents a salient reason.
